source_anchors.operation: Data hydration: accepts compression1,5,6 and primary coordinate/intensity roles; pairing and ordering defects recorded.
Constructor source defaults: full metadata true, lossy true, mass accuracy0.0001; batch size uninitialized.
Full experiment read chooses RUN_EXTRA mzML when configured, otherwise SQL projection; primary arrays hydrated separately.
getRunID requires exactly one RUN row, despite message describing only excess rows.
Selected spectrum/chromatogram reads use SQL ID membership and caller output containers; source empty-input preconditions.
Counts and RT selection; nonpositive delta uses >= and LIMIT1 without ORDER BY.
Chromatogram SQL projection uses inner joins to precursor and product.
Spectrum SQL projection uses left joins to precursor/product.
writeExperiment commits run information, chromatograms, spectra through separate operations.
Run filename uses bound bytes; full snapshot clears primary points and auxiliary arrays before mzML serialization.
Schema creation removes an existing database; source leaves handler ID counters unchanged.
Index declarations include precursor/product indexes accidentally attached to DATA.
Spectrum writes: raw-double zlib or Numpress linear/slof with zlib; m/z configured absolute accuracy; SQL metadata projection and staged inserts.
Chromatogram writes: corresponding encoding; RT linear accuracy hardcoded0.05 seconds.
START_SECTION resets test counters/state, not numeric tolerances; END_SECTION571 calls postprocessing without tolerance reset.
TOLERANCE_ABSOLUTE assigns the shared global; neighboring relative macro assigns its global.
endSectionPostProcess does not restore numeric tolerances.

native_policy_reviewed.feature: sqmass (requires sqlite and mzml codec closure)
native_policy_reviewed.configuration: Source lossy=true/fullmetadata=true/accuracy0.0001 defaults; initialized batch500; finite nonpositive accuracy preserves ordinary fixed-point sentinel; atomic config validation.
native_policy_reviewed.selection: Nonempty unique nonnegative i64 SQL IDs, ascendingID results; empty RT restriction selects all. Nonpositive RT delta picks earliest qualifyingRT thenID.
native_policy_reviewed.errors: SQLite Error::Io retaining cause; malformed input checked errors; unsupported metadata Error::Unsupported.
native_policy_reviewed.metadata: Full snapshot uses native mzML subset; auxiliary arrays defaultReject or explicitSource drop; peptide IDs and unsupported mzML fields still fail; SQL-only metadata loss requires Source policy.
native_policy_reviewed.transactions: One read transaction per public operation; atomic writes, counters aftercommit; builder run snapshot can precede records and is validated at read.
native_policy_reviewed.numeric: Compression1/5/6; raw little-endianf64; finite checked f32 intensities; distinct paired roles and lengths.
native_policy_reviewed.limits: Materialization/scans/codec budgets; no hard SQLite virtual-machine timeout or totalprocessRSS guarantee.
native_policy_reviewed.short_coordinates: Native lossy writer falls back to supported lossless code1 for coordinate arrays with fewer than3values; nonempty Numpress output must have finite positive fixedpoint.
native_policy_reviewed.run_id_owner: Dedicated MSExperiment.sql_run_id; pairedmzML fixture settings comparison removes legacy sqMassRunID metadata key from expectation.
